title: Confirmación de reserva y petición especial
scenario: Responder a una reserva de hotel con petición especial

content.studentInstructions: Lee la solicitud de reserva y redacta una respuesta profesional. Debes confirmar la información principal y responder a la petición especial.
content.teacherNotes: Puede usarse como prueba breve de writing contextualizado para ciclos de Turismo o Gestión de Alojamientos.

sections.title: Guest request
sections.body: Dear hotel team, I would like to confirm my booking for 12-15 June for two adults. Could you please arrange a quiet room on a high floor? We will arrive at approximately 22:30. Is late check-in possible?
tasks: Confirm the dates and number of guests.
Answer the high-floor room request politely.
Use a professional opening and closing.

sections.title: Assessment criteria
sections.body: The answer should be clear, polite and complete. It should include booking details, late arrival information and a realistic response to the room preference.

answerKey: Late check-in is possible; the reception should be informed or instructions should be provided.
The room request can be confirmed subject to availability.
